<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/license/status"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the state of the installation's license, its limits and the usage counted against them (seats active in the last 30 days, runs this month), with warnings to act on. With enforcement on, `read_only` means the API refuses writes until a valid license is installed; with `enforcement: false` nothing is refused. Any authenticated user may read it.

</ParamsDetails>
